text: The authors contrast their protocol with Irving et al.'s original debate, in which only a sub-component has to be judged to validate the whole debate. They report that judging full debate transcripts is already useful for producing expert labels with non-experts and untrustworthy experts, across LLM and human judges.
title: Khan et al. replace Irving et al.'s sub-component judging with full-transcript judging
